message: Nineteen more credential-bearing types stop deriving Debug: inbound API keys, bearer tokens and Basic/Digest passwords, the JWT HMAC secret, the OIDC client and cookie secrets, stored refresh tokens, outbound OAuth and vault secrets, AI provider keys, usage-sink write keys, the CSRF and crawl-ledger signing keys, the admin session key, mesh enrollment tokens, and the config-side twins of the Vault, Entra and toolkit credentials. A CI guard now refuses a tree where any registered type regains its derive.
